Love this game. Many thousands of hours of mine were spent modding this game. 

Sadly I can't stand the creation club though, I hate having to switch to a pre-creation club version of the game, and removing any remaining creation club files.

They also keep updating the game and breaking people's mods without warning.
There's always something new to find.  Also, northern lights with three moons.  Nuff said.
Honestly looking back this game isnt good.

I don't even know how many times I have started and restarted this game. It is by far my most favorite game I have ever played. I like the open world and multiple quests and side quests. I have not found anything like it (for me), which is why I keep coming back to it.

This version still needs a bunch of fan-fixes to work properly. Tons of easy-to-fix bugs that you need mods to solve. So you install  a mod manager, script extender AND mods for those to work. Then you need another mod because of course they disable achievements just to make the game playable.

Pure Bethesda bs. 
Unplayable unless you want to spend more then an hour applying fan-made fixes. And even THEN some very egregious bugs persist. (Male characters using female grunts and vice versa) This for a 15-year old game's "special edition". Just embarrassing, downloading a pirated version that has all these fixes included is way less of a hassle. Do not buy.

Great Elder Scrolls game. very big world, so many quests to pick and different factions to join  although it may get to feel repetitive between the quests like when in the companions where we either ask vilkas or aela, radiant quests they call it, and it feels repetitive with the same type of task but different people and location. But i still like the game so much. restarting a new character then growing him/her into a great figure as we progress through the game (ends up as stealth archer anyway), and the broken exploits like making a ring that has 7856574 carry points or peasant clothing that gives 99999 life is amazing even though i haven't tried it myself haha. it's a way more overhaul and upgrade from the previous game like Oblivion or Morrowind.
but to be fair, we all agrree that there are many aspects in both Morrowind and Oblivion that are great and not included in Skyrim. even to me that the voice-acting in Oblivion sounds crispier and more sharp, bold and masculine/feminine than in Skyrim. Nevertheless i'm glad that i repicked up this game a few years ago after feeling that it was a weird game then refunded it, eventually i bought it back. and boy, thank God for the mods especially Beth.INI to make us who have low spec devices to run at decent experience.
This game is absolutely wonderful because it has the complete package of fun quests with a perfect save system. If you also add mods to the equation this already big game will grow to amazing levels.
A perfectly balanced game with ZERO bugs

I bought Skyrim on November 2nd and have been playing this game for a year. I've had several lives, become dovakhiin multiple times, and I know one thing: I haven't even fully explored this game yet. Secret caves I overlooked or whatever. I've become dragon blood. I wanted to play various builds in a role-playing game, but it always ended up as a stealth archer. Skyrim is the only game I still play today (besides Minecraft). This shows how much this game has revolutionized the gaming scene. Thank you Bethesda for this beautiful game, which had always given me joy on good and bad days, except for that stupid magician in Meridia's quest. Thank you for your service.🏹⚔❤💞

Skyrim has long been my favorite among video games; it has been with me through my late childhood up through my adult life. I have always played it on console before, however I recently got a computer and am now playing through my favorite adventures anew on PC. Skyrim will always be my second love in life after my partner, and I absolutely recommend spending the many late nights it will cost you to fully enjoy the depths of this game. Even years later this game has aged like wine and only gotten better with time... The Creation Club content for Anniversary Edition offers a fresh new way to come back to Skyrim if you've been here before and for those enjoying the journey for the first time, this world offers countless hours of endless adventure, discovery, and exploration.   I hope this game can provide you as many wonderful memories as it did for me!

I love everything about Skyrim. To me, this game is so special. I don't think they'll ever come out with a better Elder Scrolls game. I have no faith in ES6. It wont have the soul that Skyrim has. It just wont.

If you still don't have Skyrim yet, get it before they remaster it cuz they could remove this version from the store like they did with oldrim, if or when a remaster comes out.

So this might be a Bit of a Hot Take, but Its Still Solid as a Game, The Anniversary Edition upgrade is a Meaningful addition and Decently worth the Price. So Say what you will but Skyrim is still one of the best RPG's we have had, yes we have things like cyberpunk, the witcher 3, and other halmarks, but for what it IS, Skyrim, and all its faults, is a Good Game. Yes its been rehashed remade Remastered Redone Repolished,Reuploded and Rebroken. I wont contest that the Greed is disgusting and that they should let the Title Rest. But Ultimately This Review is about 1 thing.

It's about as it stands now, THIS game. And THIS Game is still amazing, it still has all the depth of story telling, characters that we can love and hate and form our own truths with. the Special eddition has its own things and own flaws. But those ultimately havent changed the fact that I LOVE what this game is. Most of my Time has been running through Special Edition Script Extender, but I have nearly 1400 hours here, playing the patched and updated utility versions. I love this .
